about: scripts/perf-guard.py: the compiler, built in release mode from the checkout, compiling the checkout's own sources. Measured on Linux x86-64; update with scripts/perf-guard.py --update in the commit that moves a value. Tolerances are fractions of the value (tolerance) or counts (tolerance_abs).

allocated_bytes.why: Deterministic for a given source tree; the slack absorbs ordinary code growth between deliberate updates.

collections.why: Follows allocated bytes over the one-shot collection trigger; one extra collection can come from crossing a trigger boundary.

peak_rss_bytes.why: Stable within a few MB run to run; the slack covers code growth and runner differences.

main_thread_instructions.why: Stable to well under a percent with perf; compared only where perf is installed and allowed.
